heading: Rattlesnake National Recreation Area
lead: An area of land as generally depicted as the “Rattlesnake National Recreation Area” on a map entitled “Rattlesnake National Recreation area and Wilderness—Proposed”, and dated October 1, 1980, is hereby established as the Rattle­snake National Recreation Area.
